title: Giraffe Tongues Are Purple! Here's Why

beats.say: You have a pink tongue. A giraffe's tongue is purple, and up to twenty inches long! But why?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's fly to the giraffes!
A giraffe uses its long tongue to grab leaves from tall trees.
That tongue can be almost as long as your arm!
So why purple? Scientists think the dark color helps protect it from the hot sun. Like sunscreen!
What color is your tongue? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!

sources: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance: Giraffe

title: Penguins Have Knees? Yes! Here's Where

beats.say: You can bend your knees. Penguins can too, but you never see them. Why?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's waddle over to the penguins!
Penguins look like they have short little legs.
But under all those feathers, their legs are longer, with knees tucked up inside!
Their feathers cover their knees, like a cozy coat.
That's why penguins waddle, step by step.
Can you waddle like a penguin? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!

sources: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance: Penguin

title: Why Can't Elephants Jump?

beats.say: You can jump up high. An elephant never jumps, not even once. Why not?
Hi! I'm Milo. Let's stomp over to the elephants!
Elephants are the biggest animals on land.
Their legs stand straight, like strong tree trunks, to hold up their heavy bodies.
So elephants can't jump. But they can walk fast, and even swim!
And to say hello, elephants wrap their trunks together. An elephant hug!
Can you give a big hug today? Be kind to every animal. See you at the zoo!

sources: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance: Elephant
